messages.content:
Three independent readers read the same non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and decided whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis). They may agree or disagree, and a program has checked each of their quotes against the document. Your job is to make the final decision yourself, from the document.

<document>
<document 99 omitted, sha256 55a10eb6836aa786>
</document>

<hypothesis>
All Confidential Information shall be expressly identified by the Disclosing Party.
</hypothesis>

<readings>
<reading id="A">
label: Contradiction
confidence: 80
reason: The NDA treats all information furnished by the Providing Party as confidential regardless of the manner in which it is furnished, with no requirement that it be expressly identified, which contradicts the hypothesis that Confidential Information must be expressly identified.
<quote check="exact">all information provided by the Providing Party in connection with the Business Under Discussion to the Receiving Partner</quote>
<quote check="exact">regardless of the manner in which it is so furnished</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="B">
label: Contradiction
confidence: 82
reason: The agreement treats all information furnished in connection with the Business Under Discussion as confidential regardless of how it is furnished, with no requirement that it be expressly identified or marked.
<quote check="exact">all information provided by the Providing Party in connection with the Business Under Discussion</quote>
<quote check="exact">regardless of the manner in which it is so furnished</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="C">
label: Contradiction
confidence: 85
reason: The agreement treats all information provided as confidential regardless of how it is furnished, without requiring it to be marked or identified as confidential.
<quote check="exact">The Receiving Party agrees to treat all information provided by the Providing Party in connection with the Business Under Discussion</quote>
<quote check="exact">regardless of the manner in which it is so furnished</quote>
</reading>
</readings>

The readings are evidence about where to look, not votes: a majority can be wrong, and a quote marked "missing" was not found in the document. Read the relevant parts of the document yourself.

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give 1 to 3 quotes copied character for character from the document (no paraphrase, no ellipses), each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. They will be checked against the document. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is correct. Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label":"Contradiction","confidence":82,"quotes":["The Receiving Party agrees to treat all information provided by the Providing Party in connection with the Business Under Discussion","regardless of the manner in which it is so furnished"],"reason":"The agreement treats all information provided in connection with the Business Under Discussion as strictly confidential regardless of how it is furnished, so it does not need to be expressly identified as confidential."}
